provenanceStatement: Every sample is produced during the test run from FFmpeg's own synthetic sources: the testsrc2 video generator and the sine tone generator. No third-party recording, no user library file, and no redistributable asset is involved, so no sample is ever committed to the repository.

samples.recipe: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 64k -t 3
-f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -c:v libx265 -preset ultrafast -x265-params log-level=error -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a eac3 -b:a 192k -t 3
-f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -c:v mpeg4 -vtag XVID -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k -t 3
-f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a pcm_s16le -t 3
-f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 200k -deadline realtime -cpu-used 8 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a libopus -b:a 64k -t 3
-f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -c:v libsvtav1 -preset 12 -crf 50 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a libopus -b:a 64k -t 3

-f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=880:duration=3 -i "{{companion}}" -map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a -map 3:s -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a:0 eac3 -ac:a:0 6 -c:a:1 aac -b:a:1 64k -c:s srt -metadata:s:a:0 language=spa -metadata:s:a:1 language=eng -metadata:s:s:0 language=spa -t 3
samples.notes: The Spanish 5.1 track is announced first.

samples.recipe: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=880:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -i "{{companion}}" -map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a -map 3:s -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a:0 aac -b:a:0 64k -c:a:1 eac3 -ac:a:1 6 -c:s srt -metadata:s:a:0 language=eng -metadata:s:a:1 language=spa -metadata:s:s:0 language=spa -t 3
samples.notes: The same two languages, announced in the opposite order, so an index-based selection would pick the wrong one.

samples.recipe: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -ac 2 -b:a 96k -t 3
-f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a eac3 -ac 6 -t 3
-f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=3 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a flac -ac 8 -t 3
samples.notes: E-AC-3 in this FFmpeg build refuses 7.1, so the eight-channel row uses FLAC, which carries the layout losslessly.

samples.recipe: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -an -c:v libx265 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p10le -color_primaries bt2020 -color_trc smpte2084 -colorspace bt2020nc -x265-params "log-level=error:hdr-opt=1:repeat-headers=1:colorprim=bt2020:transfer=smpte2084:colormatrix=bt2020nc:master-display=G(13250,34500)B(7500,3000)R(34000,16000)WP(15635,16450)L(10000000,1):max-cll=1000,400"
samples.notes: HDR10: BT.2020 primaries with the SMPTE ST 2084 perceptual quantiser and mastering display metadata.

samples.recipe: -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=3 -an -c:v libx265 -preset ultrafast -x265-params log-level=error -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709
samples.notes: The SDR counterpart of the HDR10 row, so the two paths can be compared on the same hardware.
AVS2 is a real, standardised codec that the pinned LibVLC build has no decoder for. The container parses and the track is announced, but the engine reports no codec description and decodes no frame.
